_what: Every screen arranged in place (src/workspace/screen-own-arrangement.ts): each screen's own arrangement is kept per person at `kept_prefix` + the screen's id. `stack_rows_that_do_not_fit` draws a row whose pieces do not fit at their usable width as a stack (a phone), unless the row says its own width to stack below. `chrome` is which parts of the arrangement show (parts/screen-arrangement/read-data/chrome-visibility.ts zones, false hides): `arranged` while the person is looking at an arranged screen (its pieces read as one screen: no tab bars, no frames), `arranging` while they arrange it (everything shows: tab bars, each piece's …, the edges to drag). `words` are the rows the screen's … offers and what each says when done.

words.arrange_said: Arranging: drag a screen in, split a piece from its …, drag any edge
words.back_said: This screen is as it started
